meta.source: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database, NASA Exoplanet Archive, GCAT (J. McDowell), USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
meta.provenance: Snapshot taken 2026-11-01 by tools/fetch_raw.py and tools/build_pool.py. Asteroid and comet data courtesy of NASA/JPL-Caltech; exoplanet and host-star data from the NASA Exoplanet Archive; satellite and rocket data from GCAT: McDowell, Jonathan C., 2020, General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects, Release 1.8.8, planet4589.org/space/gcat (CC BY 4.0); feature names from the USGS/IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature.
meta.selection: 78,561 asteroids (every named one, every near-Earth asteroid, trans-Neptunian object and Centaur); 4,083 comets; 6,451 confirmed exoplanets and the 4,847 stars that host them; 13,206 cataloged payloads and 6,079 rocket bodies (series of near-identical spacecraft thinned to 25: 14,646 payloads and 212 rocket bodies left out); 16,124 IAU-approved named features on 50 bodies.
